input.quote: 15.4 Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, neither Party makes any representation or extends any warranties of any kind either express or implied, including, but not limited to, warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, noninfringement or validity of any patents issued or pending
input.rationale: Article 15 contains only mutual corporate/authority representations and Array IP representations, all given solely \"as of the Effective Date\" (p0681, p0691), plus a mutual disclaimer of implied warranties (p0711). Article IX defers product specifications and quality terms to future supply and quality agreements (p0501, p0510) and contains no conformance warranty or remedy. There is therefore no express performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the document and no repair, replacement or refund remedy, which fails every fallback element. The disclaimer is prefaced by \"Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement\", so a new express warranty is not swallowed and no carve-out is needed. We insert a short Section 15.5 at the fallback level (90 days deliverables/software against documentation, 30 days services, repair/replace or refund) rather than the preferred 12-month/professional-and-workmanlike package.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Insert an express conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy as Section 15.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 15 contains only Effective-Date representations and a mutual disclaimer, with no conformance warranty or remedy for what Array delivers or performs. We have added a short Section 15.5 at our fallback position: 90 days for deliverables/software against documentation, 30 days for services, with repair, replacement or refund.

ops.text: 15.5 Performance Warranty. Array warrants that (a) for ninety (90) days following delivery, each deliverable and item of software supplied by Array will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications, and (b) for thirty (30) days following performance, services performed by Array under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement. For any breach of this warranty, Array shall, at Ono's election, repair or replace the non-conforming deliverable, software or services, or refund the amounts paid for them.
